t.E941.agn: In 1980 JECFA decided that there was no need to set an acceptable daily intake (ADI) for nitrogen (no ADI necessary); the functions listed by JECFA are freezant, propellant and packaging gas. In 2023 EFSA published a call for data for the re-evaluation of gaseous additives, including nitrogen.
t.E941.found.0: In the EU, may be used in many foods at quantum satis (as much as needed)
t.E941.prod: A gas obtained by fractional distillation of liquid air (fractionation).
t.E941.regx.0: No ADI considered necessary (no ADI necessary).
t.E941.regx.1: Group I additive; generally authorised at quantum satis (as much as needed).
t.E941.regx.2: A call for data for the re-evaluation of gaseous additives was published in 2023 (deadline 31 March 2024).
t.E941.summary: Nitrogen gas. Replaces air in crisp and coffee packaging to prevent staling; liquid nitrogen is used in making ice cream.
t.E941.what: A packaging gas that slows oxidation by replacing air in the package; also used as a propellant and freezant.
